disposition_reason: Materials chemistry with a single in vitro cytotoxicity test; not a dietary exposure or toxicity study.

study.method: Cell viability assay in HL-60 cells; structural and adsorption analyses

non_numeric_findings: SU-101 IC80 = 1000 µg/mL in HL-60 cells after 24 h (p. 16799).
Authors state, citing earlier work, that median lethal doses of bismuth and many of its compounds are about 5 g/kg in rats (p. 16796, background).
